user_metadata.name: Not null check
user_metadata.description: The column must always be populated; a null value fails the check.

user_metadata.name: Value is present
user_metadata.description: The text column must be populated and must not be an empty or whitespace-only string.

user_metadata.name: Key is unique
user_metadata.description: Every value in the column must be distinct; the column identifies a single row, such as a primary key or a natural key.

user_metadata.name: Valid email address format
user_metadata.description: The email column must contain a syntactically valid email address, with a local part, an @ sign and a domain.

user_metadata.name: Timestamp is not in the future
user_metadata.description: The date or timestamp column must not hold a value later than the current time; a future timestamp indicates a clock or ingestion fault.

user_metadata.name: Monetary amount is positive
user_metadata.description: The monetary amount, total or price column must be zero or greater; a negative amount is not a valid value.

user_metadata.name: Status is in the allowed set
user_metadata.description: The status or state column must hold one of the enumerated allowed values; anything else is an unrecognised status.

user_metadata.name: Start timestamp is before end timestamp
user_metadata.description: Compares two timestamp columns and requires the earlier event to come first, for example an order placed before it was shipped.

user_metadata.name: Valid ISO country code
user_metadata.description: The country code column must be a two-letter uppercase ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code.

user_metadata.name: Valid ISO currency code
user_metadata.description: The currency column must be a three-letter uppercase ISO 4217 currency code such as USD, EUR or GBP.

user_metadata.name: Valid phone number format
user_metadata.description: The telephone or mobile number column must look like a dialable phone number, optionally with a leading country prefix.

user_metadata.name: Valid URL format
user_metadata.description: The website, link or URL column must start with an http or https scheme.

user_metadata.name: Count is not negative
user_metadata.description: The count or quantity column must be zero or greater; a negative count cannot occur.

user_metadata.name: Percentage is between 0 and 100
user_metadata.description: The percentage or rate column must fall between 0 and 100 inclusive.

user_metadata.name: Text length within bound
user_metadata.description: The text column must not exceed the agreed maximum character length.

user_metadata.name: Valid ICD-10 diagnosis code
user_metadata.description: The diagnosis code column must match the ICD-10 alphanumeric coding pattern used for clinical classification.

user_metadata.name: Valid SNOMED CT concept identifier
user_metadata.description: The clinical concept column must hold a numeric SNOMED CT identifier drawn from the published terminology.

user_metadata.name: Valid national provider identifier
user_metadata.description: The provider column must be a ten digit national provider identifier issued to a clinician or practice.

user_metadata.name: Medication dosage is positive
user_metadata.description: The dosage or strength column must be greater than zero; a non-positive dose cannot be dispensed.

user_metadata.name: Body mass index is physiologically plausible
user_metadata.description: The body mass index column must sit inside a plausible human range rather than an arithmetic artefact.

user_metadata.name: Discharge follows admission
user_metadata.description: Compares the admission and discharge timestamps of an encounter and requires the discharge not to precede the admission.

user_metadata.name: Laboratory result unit is recognised
user_metadata.description: The unit of measure column must be one of the standard laboratory units agreed for the assay.

user_metadata.name: Valid IBAN
user_metadata.description: The bank account column must be a syntactically valid international bank account number including the country prefix and check digits.

user_metadata.name: Valid SWIFT BIC
user_metadata.description: The bank identifier column must be an eight or eleven character SWIFT business identifier code.

user_metadata.name: Debits equal credits
user_metadata.description: Compares the debit and credit amount columns of a journal line and requires the two to reconcile.

user_metadata.name: Tax rate is within statutory bounds
user_metadata.description: The tax rate column must sit between zero and the maximum statutory rate for the jurisdiction.

user_metadata.name: Fiscal period label is well formed
user_metadata.description: The fiscal period column must follow the year and period naming convention used by the finance close.

user_metadata.name: Settlement date follows trade date
user_metadata.description: Compares the trade and settlement date columns and requires settlement not to precede the trade.

user_metadata.name: Cost centre code is recognised
user_metadata.description: The cost centre column must reference a code that exists in the chart of accounts.

user_metadata.name: Credit score is in scale
user_metadata.description: The credit score column must fall inside the issuing bureau's published scale.

user_metadata.name: Valid EAN-13 barcode
user_metadata.description: The barcode column must be a thirteen digit EAN with a correct trailing check digit.

user_metadata.name: Stock keeping unit follows the naming standard
user_metadata.description: The SKU column must follow the agreed product coding standard for the catalogue.

user_metadata.name: On-hand stock is not negative
user_metadata.description: The on-hand inventory column must be zero or greater; negative stock indicates an unposted movement.

user_metadata.name: Discount fraction is between zero and one
user_metadata.description: The discount column must express a fraction between zero and one rather than a percentage.

user_metadata.name: Warehouse code is recognised
user_metadata.description: The warehouse or site column must reference a location present in the facility master.

user_metadata.name: Delivery date follows dispatch date
user_metadata.description: Compares the dispatch and delivery date columns and requires delivery not to precede dispatch.

user_metadata.name: Shipment weight is positive
user_metadata.description: The gross weight column must be greater than zero for a physical consignment.

user_metadata.name: Valid carrier SCAC code
user_metadata.description: The carrier column must be a two to four letter standard carrier alpha code.

user_metadata.name: Latitude is within range
user_metadata.description: The latitude column must fall between minus ninety and ninety degrees.

user_metadata.name: Longitude is within range
user_metadata.description: The longitude column must fall between minus one hundred and eighty and one hundred and eighty degrees.

user_metadata.name: Valid UK postcode
user_metadata.description: The postcode column must match the United Kingdom outward and inward code format.

user_metadata.name: Valid US ZIP code
user_metadata.description: The ZIP column must be a five digit code, optionally followed by a four digit extension.

user_metadata.name: Timezone name is recognised
user_metadata.description: The timezone column must name an entry from the IANA timezone database.

user_metadata.name: Valid three-letter country code
user_metadata.description: The country column must be a three letter uppercase ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 code.

user_metadata.name: Valid UUID
user_metadata.description: The identifier column must be a canonical hyphen-separated universally unique identifier.

user_metadata.name: Valid NHS number
user_metadata.description: The patient identifier column must be a ten digit NHS number with a valid modulus eleven check digit.

user_metadata.name: Date of birth is in the past
user_metadata.description: The date of birth column must not be later than today.

user_metadata.name: Age is plausible
user_metadata.description: The age column must sit inside a plausible human lifespan.

user_metadata.name: Valid National Insurance number
user_metadata.description: The National Insurance column must follow the two letter, six digit, one letter format.

user_metadata.name: Production data holds no test records
user_metadata.description: The name column must not contain placeholder or test markers that indicate a non-production record.

user_metadata.name: HTTP status code is recognised
user_metadata.description: The response status column must be a valid HTTP status code.

user_metadata.name: Latency is not negative
user_metadata.description: The latency or duration column must be zero or greater.

user_metadata.name: Valid semantic version
user_metadata.description: The version column must follow the major, minor and patch semantic versioning form.

user_metadata.name: Log level is recognised
user_metadata.description: The severity column must be one of the standard logging levels.

user_metadata.name: Valid hostname
user_metadata.description: The host column must be a syntactically valid DNS hostname.

user_metadata.name: Valid IPv4 address
user_metadata.description: The address column must be a dotted quad IPv4 address with each octet in range.

user_metadata.name: Valid MAC address
user_metadata.description: The hardware address column must be a colon or hyphen separated MAC address.

user_metadata.name: Payload parses as JSON
user_metadata.description: The payload column must contain text that parses as a JSON document.

user_metadata.name: Checksum is present
user_metadata.description: The checksum column must be populated so the record's integrity can be verified downstream.

user_metadata.name: Meter reading does not decrease
user_metadata.description: Compares the previous and current cumulative meter readings and requires the newer reading not to fall.

user_metadata.name: Temperature reading is plausible
user_metadata.description: The temperature column must sit inside the sensor's rated operating range.

user_metadata.name: Pressure is not negative
user_metadata.description: The pressure column must be zero or greater in absolute terms.

user_metadata.name: Batch code follows the plant convention
user_metadata.description: The batch or lot column must follow the plant's coding convention for traceability.

user_metadata.name: Shift code is recognised
user_metadata.description: The shift column must be one of the operating shifts defined for the site.

user_metadata.name: Yield percentage is in range
user_metadata.description: The yield column must express a percentage between zero and one hundred.

user_metadata.name: Calibration date is not in the future
user_metadata.description: The calibration date column must not be later than the current date.

user_metadata.name: Campaign source is recognised
user_metadata.description: The campaign source column must be one of the tracked acquisition channels.

user_metadata.name: Click-through rate is a fraction
user_metadata.description: The click-through rate column must be a fraction between zero and one.

user_metadata.name: Session duration is positive
user_metadata.description: The session duration column must be greater than zero for a recorded visit.

user_metadata.name: Marketing consent flag is set
user_metadata.description: The consent column must be populated so lawful basis for contact can be demonstrated.

user_metadata.name: Valid locale tag
user_metadata.description: The locale column must be a language and region tag such as en-GB.

user_metadata.name: Bounce rate is a percentage
user_metadata.description: The bounce rate column must express a percentage between zero and one hundred.

user_metadata.name: Leaving date follows joining date
user_metadata.description: Compares the joining and leaving date columns and requires the leaving date not to precede the joining date.

user_metadata.name: Salary is positive
user_metadata.description: The salary or compensation column must be greater than zero.

user_metadata.name: Full time equivalent is a fraction
user_metadata.description: The FTE column must express a fraction between zero and one.

user_metadata.name: Grade band is recognised
user_metadata.description: The grade column must be one of the job bands published by reward.

user_metadata.name: Employee is not their own manager
user_metadata.description: Compares the employee and manager identifier columns and requires them to differ.

user_metadata.name: Retention class is assigned
user_metadata.description: The retention class column must be populated so the record's disposal schedule is known.

user_metadata.name: Data classification is recognised
user_metadata.description: The classification column must be one of the agreed sensitivity labels.

user_metadata.name: Data owner is recorded
user_metadata.description: The owner column must name an accountable owner for the record.

user_metadata.name: Source system is recognised
user_metadata.description: The source system column must reference a registered upstream system.

user_metadata.name: Ingestion timestamp is not in the future
user_metadata.description: The ingestion timestamp column must not be later than the current time.
